mapper.insert: INSERT INTO semantic_lexical_recovery_integrity(index_version,chunk_count,term_count,statistic_count) SELECT #{indexVersion},#{chunkCount},#{termCount},COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_term_stats WHERE index_version=#{indexVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_lexical_recovery_integrity i JOIN semantic_lexical_index_state s ON s.index_version=i.index_version WHERE i.index_version=#{indexVersion} AND s.status='RECOVERY_READY' AND s.content_fingerprint=#{revision} AND i.chunk_count=s.active_chunk_count AND i.chunk_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_chunks c WHERE c.index_version=i.index_version AND c.build_status='READY') AND i.term_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_terms t WHERE t.index_version=i.index_version) AND i.statistic_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_term_stats t WHERE t.index_version=i.index_version))

SELECT index_version AS indexVersion, tokenizer_version AS tokenizerVersion, active_chunk_count AS activeChunkCount, average_weighted_length AS averageWeightedLength, content_fingerprint AS contentFingerprint, status, completed_at AS completedAt FROM semantic_lexical_index_state WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND status = 'RECOVERY_READY'

SELECT target, chunk_id AS chunkId, document_id AS documentId, parent_key AS parentKey, content_hash AS contentHash, weighted_length AS weightedLength FROM semantic_lexical_chunks WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND build_status = 'READY' AND
(target = #{doc.target} AND chunk_id = #{doc.chunkId})

SELECT target, chunk_id AS chunkId, term, field_kind AS fieldKind, term_frequency AS termFrequency, field_weight AS fieldWeight FROM semantic_lexical_terms WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND
(target = #{doc.target} AND chunk_id = #{doc.chunkId})

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_chunks WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion}) AS chunkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_terms WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion}) AS termCount, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_lexical_term_stats s LEFT JOIN (SELECT term, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(target, ':', chunk_id)) AS frequency FROM semantic_lexical_terms WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} GROUP BY term) actual ON actual.term = s.term WHERE s.index_version = #{indexVersion} AND (actual.frequency IS NULL OR s.document_frequency != actual.frequency)) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.term) FROM semantic_lexical_terms t LEFT JOIN semantic_lexical_term_stats s ON s.index_version = t.index_version AND s.term = t.term WHERE t.index_version = #{indexVersion} AND s.term IS NULL)) AS statisticMismatches

SELECT doc.target AS target, c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, c.parent_key AS parentKey, c.content_hash AS contentHash, doc.title AS documentTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.parent_title, ''), c.chunk_title, '') AS parentTitle, COALESCE(c.chunk_title, '') AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS body FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.activation_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(c.quality_status, 'PASS') IN ('PASS', 'REVIEW') UNION ALL SELECT doc.document_type AS target, c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, CONCAT('rag:', c.document_id, ':', SHA2(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.parent_section_title, ''), doc.title), 256)) AS parentKey, c.content_hash AS contentHash, doc.title AS documentTitle, COALESCE(c.parent_section_title, '') AS parentTitle, COALESCE(c.chunk_title, '') AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS body FROM rag_document_chunks c JOIN rag_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.quality_status, 'PASS') IN ('PASS', 'REVIEW') AND c.chunk_version = ( SELECT MAX(c2.chunk_version) FROM rag_document_chunks c2 WHERE c2.document_id = c.document_id AND c2.use_yn = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c2.quality_status, 'PASS') IN ('PASS', 'REVIEW') ) ORDER BY target, chunkId
SELECT content_fingerprint FROM semantic_lexical_index_state WHERE status = 'READY' ORDER BY completed_at DESC, index_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO semantic_lexical_chunks ( index_version, target, chunk_id, document_id, parent_key, content_hash, weighted_length, build_status, completed_at ) VALUES
(#{indexVersion}, #{chunk.target}, #{chunk.chunkId}, #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.parentKey}, #{chunk.contentHash}, #{chunk.weightedLength}, 'BUILDING', NULL)

INSERT INTO semantic_lexical_terms ( index_version, target, chunk_id, term, field_kind, term_frequency, field_weight ) VALUES
(#{indexVersion}, #{term.target}, #{term.chunkId}, #{term.term}, #{term.fieldKind}, #{term.termFrequency}, #{term.fieldWeight})

INSERT INTO semantic_lexical_term_stats ( index_version, term, document_frequency ) SELECT #{indexVersion}, term, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(target, ':', chunk_id)) FROM semantic_lexical_terms WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} GROUP BY term
mapper.update: UPDATE semantic_lexical_chunks SET build_status = 'READY', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND build_status = 'BUILDING'

UPDATE semantic_lexical_index_state SET content_fingerprint = #{contentFingerprint}, active_chunk_count = #{activeChunkCount}, average_weighted_length = #{averageWeightedLength}, status = 'READY', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND status = 'BUILDING'

UPDATE semantic_lexical_index_state SET content_fingerprint = #{contentFingerprint}, active_chunk_count = #{activeChunkCount}, average_weighted_length = #{averageWeightedLength}, status = 'RECOVERY_READY', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND status = 'BUILDING' AND LEFT(index_version, 9) = 'recovery_'
UPDATE semantic_lexical_index_state SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE index_version = #{indexVersion} AND status = 'BUILDING'
